Cross-enterprise, digital workflows. Now.

The Now Platform, anchored by App Engine, is a rapid application modeling and development engine that lets platform users quickly model, build, integrate, and deploy custom applications within ServiceNow.

With pre-built service templates, Flow Designer reusable actions, and IntegrationHub spokes, it expands your existing ServiceNow services to fit your organization's evolving business demands — without ripping and replacing applications every time.

Build Agent now extends this further, letting teams describe an application in natural language and get a governed, deployable starting point in return — with RaptorDB keeping the workflow data underneath fast at scale.

Who is it for?

If your organization is already using ServiceNow — ITSM, ITOM, or CSM — it's an ideal time to leverage the Now Platform. Exterprise's team of experts will:

01

Design

Use App Engine Studio to customize user and process flows and map them to ServiceNow components and modules — visually, without hand-coding the scaffolding.

02

Develop & Integrate

Flow Designer automates the process logic while IntegrationHub connects the new application to other line-of-business systems — no separate integration project required.

03

Deploy

Ensure the custom application can be deployed within minutes, inside the ServiceNow framework — with AI Control Tower governance applied from day one.
